changes_from_supersedes: palette: land bands lifted 0.12 toward #d8d2a8, sea shelf one step darker, shadow inks deeper (see palette)
regional layers: hillshade smoothed over 5 cells with higher thresholds and a 4-neighbour speckle cleanup; band dither margin 0.14
geometry unchanged: same grids, bboxes and route_inset fit as v03; elevation bands and shelf limits unchanged
offline: tile sha256 and observed source families taken from the v02 bake's per-tile records (no network request)
mask: Natural Earth land and lake rings of the map's own us_east geodata (even-odd, holes are lakes), cell-centre rule

classes.coast_band: one transparent cell on each side of every coast and lake shore
classes.no_lake_bathymetry: lake shading is a shore band from the lake rings only

sources.observed_how: x-amz-meta-x-imagery-sources response header of every tile, read by the v02 bake (2026-10-17) and re-checked here against its per-tile records
attribution_lines: Global ETOPO1 terrain data U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
Global GMTED2010 and SRTM terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
sources.attribution_note: Tilezen's example USGS line also names United States 3DEP (formerly NED); no tile used here lists a 3DEP/NED (or CDEM) file, so that clause is omitted.
